verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` regex omits `attention.dense.weight`, so only 3 of the 4 projection matrices per layer (48 tensors) are cast to bfloat16 instead of all 64, violating Required result clause 1 ("Cast exactly the 64 projection matrices... to bfloat16"). The script's own assertion is bugged to match (`== 48` instead of `== 64`), so it passes internally but violates the Required checks clause "exactly 64 tensors are bfloat16." As a result `attention.dense.weight` incorrectly stays float32 in the output for all 16 layers.
